title: Chronic hepatitis etiologies, progression and laboratory monitoring
guide: NASH as most common and alcohol as second most common cause, pediatric etiologies (alpha-1 antitrypsin, Indian childhood cirrhosis), progression to cirrhosis and 2-year life expectancy in decompensation, fatigue as most common symptom, FibroScan indication for hepatomegaly, and ALT > AST (<150 U/L) transaminase monitoring.

title: Screening, early etiology-directed therapy and cirrhosis fibrosis staging
guide: Routine screening targets, early phlebotomy for hemochromatosis, penicillamine for Wilson's, weight loss for NASH, architectural loss replaced by nodules and fibrous septation, tawny brown appearance, and the 4-stage fibrosis scale (mild periportal, 1+ septation, 2+ bridging, 3+ nodules/cirrhosis).

title: Portal hypertension pathophysiology, hyperdynamic state and clinical stigmata
guide: Mechanical nodular compression versus functional decreased intrasinusoidal NO, systemic NO and gut endotoxemia driving hyperdynamic circulation, RAAS and ADH stimulation, splenomegaly as first clinical finding, thrombocytopenia as first biochemical finding, palmar erythema, and the alcohol-associated triad (alopecia, parotid swelling, Dupuytren's).

title: Endocrine disturbances, caput medusae and decompensated cirrhosis
guide: Absence of 5-alpha reductase causing lack of DHT with gynecomastia and testicular atrophy, decreased SHBG with female hypoestrogenism, caput medusae centrifugal flow, jaundice as decompensation herald, and the decompensation triad (ascites, encephalopathy, variceal bleed).
